business.name: Aashu Smoky
business.tagline: Listen, Coffee, Records & a Place to Pause
business.address: 1237 Barrington Street, Halifax, Nova Scotia, B3J 1Y2

menu.name: Smoky Maple Caramel Latte
menu.description: Double espresso infused with house-smoked Nova Scotia maple syrup, velvety steamed oat milk, and a pinch of Maldon smoked sea salt.

menu.name: Pistachio Velvet Latte
menu.description: Slow-roasted Sicilian pistachio cream blended with rich espresso and warm textured milk, topped with crushed pistachio dust.

menu.name: Single Origin Cortado / Flat White
menu.description: Equal parts double ristretto espresso and silky textured microfoam. Notes of dark chocolate, roasted almond, and dried fig.

menu.name: Artisanal Pour-Over V60
menu.description: Hand-poured single origin Ethiopian Yirgacheffe. Delicate floral jasmine aroma, bergamot sweetness, and bright citrus finish.

menu.name: 24-Hour Nitro Cold Brew
menu.description: Slow steeped cold for 24 hours and infused with food-grade nitrogen for a creamy Guinness-like head and naturally sweet finish.

menu.name: Iced Smoked Vanilla Shakerato
menu.description: Double espresso shaken vigorously over ice with Madagascar vanilla bean extract and turbinado sugar, strained into chilled coupe glassware.

menu.name: Uji Ceremonial Matcha Latte
menu.description: First harvest Japanese ceremonial matcha hand-whisked with bamboo chasen, paired with organic oat milk and wildflower honey.

menu.name: Smoked Chili Avocado Sourdough
menu.description: Crushed Hass avocado on toasted heritage sourdough with smoked chili flakes, pickled shallots, microgreens, and cold-pressed olive oil.

menu.name: Truffle & Fontina Grilled Panini
menu.description: Fontina cheese, shaved black truffle oil, roasted wild mushrooms, and arugula pressed to crispy golden perfection on ciabatta bread.

menu.name: House Espresso Tiramisu
menu.description: Traditional savoiardi ladyfingers soaked in our signature house espresso and aged rum, layered with whipped mascarpone cream and Valrhona cocoa.

menu.name: Burnt Basque Cheesecake
menu.description: Caramelized deeply on top with a molten, custardy center. Served with seasonal berry compote and smoked sea salt crystals.

menu.name: Vinyl Session & Coffee Flight (for 2)
menu.description: Two specialty coffees of your choice, a shared dessert plate, and 45 minutes of reserved listening at our master hi-fi turntable booth.

testimonials.name: Marcus Vance
testimonials.quote: Aashu Smoky is the rarest kind of sanctuary in the city. The turntable setup is audiophile-grade, and the Smoky Maple Caramel Latte is genuinely the best espresso drink in town.

testimonials.name: Elena Rostova
testimonials.quote: There is nothing like sipping a single origin pour-over while browsing through their curated vinyl collection. The warm wooden acoustics and welcoming staff make you want to stay all afternoon.

testimonials.name: David Chen
testimonials.quote: From the Burnt Basque Cheesecake to the calm, analog atmosphere, Aashu Smoky delivers an experience that respect your senses and your time. Outstanding place.
